title: Fuzz Testing Setup
concept: Setting up fuzz testing with cargo-fuzz or libFuzzer — instrumenting your code and writing fuzz targets.
why: A fuzzer without proper setup finds nothing. Correct instrumentation and corpus seeding are essential for effective fuzzing.
tips: Seed your corpus with representative valid AND invalid inputs
Run with AddressSanitizer (ASan) to detect memory bugs the fuzzer would miss
Use multiple fuzz targets — each function with parsing logic deserves one
Fuzz continuously — set up nightly fuzzing runs in CI
common_mistakes: Not seeding the corpus — the fuzzer starts from nothing and wastes time discovering basic inputs
Making fuzz targets too slow — the faster they run, the more inputs tested
Ignoring the fuzzer output — every crash reproducer is a real bug
